en: Color view over a Romanian city with a tall white obelisk monument in a circular square, people walking and a few 1950s–60s cars parked. In the foreground is part of a stone statue and the ramparts of a fortress; red‑roofed houses and rolling hills fill the background. The reverse side says Carte Poștală and bears a Romanian 40‑bani stamp from a 1965 cultural anniversary series featuring a portrait.
